discovery-weak-signals.name: process-control bottleneck exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: rising device complexity increases inspection/metrology intensity

expectations-execution.name: execution and earnings conversion
expectations-execution.basis: revenue growth accompanied higher net income and record-scale annual revenue

thesisQuality.basis: FY2026 growth, profitability, service revenue and issuer commentary on AI/advanced-node process-control demand support the existing thesis score.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: FY2026 revenue rose 11.7% to $13.579B and net income rose 18.9% to $4.831B; Q4 revenue was $3.658B.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 17 market data showed a premium 46.17x trailing and 30.98x forward P/E, supporting the existing conservative valuation score.

catalystScore.basis: Issuer FY2026 results identify continued AI infrastructure, foundry/logic, memory and advanced-packaging process-control demand as the execution catalyst base.

governancePower.basis: Strong profitability and disclosed liquidity/capital structure support execution capacity while the existing score remains conservative.

alignment2036.basis: Issuer commentary links rising AI infrastructure and semiconductor complexity to greater process-control demand, aligning KLA with advanced compute manufacturing.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Product systems plus a $3.126B service business create leverage between installed tools and recurring process-control support.

bottleneckControl.basis: Issuer operating evidence supports KLA's high-value role in inspection, metrology and process control as semiconductor complexity rises.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Recurring service and strong profitability improve resilience, while premium valuation and semiconductor-cycle/export exposure remain material.

substitutionResilience.basis: Process-control intensity rises with complexity, but individual inspection/metrology steps remain contestable; the existing score reflects that balance.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong FY2026 profitability and liquidity support resilience, while semiconductor-equipment supply and customer-capex dependencies remain relevant.

pricingPower.basis: High profitability and process-control criticality support the existing pricing-power assessment without asserting monopoly immunity.

riskEvidence.basis: Premium valuation, semiconductor-cycle/export risk and customer concentration are offset by process-control leadership, service mix and strong profitability.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current full-year issuer statements and independent current valuation evidence.

scoreRecord.thesis: KLA's process-control and inspection systems occupy a high-value semiconductor manufacturing bottleneck, reinforced by recurring service revenue and strong profitability.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Premium valuation and semiconductor capex/export cyclicality can compress returns even with durable bottleneck control.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Fiscal Q1 2027 results and AI/advanced-packaging process-control demand.
